eligibilityRule: Every documented runtime export in the explicitly selected published entrypoint is implemented over the same JavaScript input domain and with the same algorithmic work; upstream-derived assertions, dense differential vectors, and identical app contracts pass; every adapter byte is measured; the LilScript Vite 8 artifact is no larger than either npm Vite 8 or public-API-preserving Closure ADVANCED in the explicitly selected transport codec; and representative throughput and retained-memory workloads show no material regression. Raw and alternate-codec sizes are diagnostics and may lose because optimizing one objective is not a promise about another. Partial, adapter-algorithm, and subset implementations are implementation backlog only and are not published as library comparisons. C/native checks are additional portability evidence where the selected API can be represented natively, not a substitute for JavaScript compatibility.

results.compatibilityNotes: Copy-on-write ImmValue draft tree lives in LilScript (no Proxies in-language). A measured JavaScript facade restores immer-like produce/current/original mutation syntax and enablePatches/produceWithPatches/applyPatches. Patch generation (assigned-key object patches + array length/index patches + replacement patches) runs in LilScript; applyPatches is restored in the facade over plain deep-cloned values (matching immer's JSON-patch ops for the contract). Covers nested object/array drafts, push/pop, property assign/delete, recipe return replacement, same-reference when unchanged, and patch round-trips. Blocked from complete: no Map/Set/Date/class/immerable drafts, no freeze/manual createDraft/finishDraft public API, and Proxy traps remain a JS-facade necessity because LilScript cannot express them.
